_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.1:7: Steinsaltz describes the zav's discharge and names the body part.
hideSteinsaltz.2:4: Steinsaltz describes a woman's bleeding and names menstruation.
hideSteinsaltz.2:5: Steinsaltz describes the sota as suspected of being unfaithful, and a murdered corpse.
hideSteinsaltz.4:9: Steinsaltz names forbidden sexual relations and impregnating a woman.
hideSteinsaltz.4:10: Steinsaltz quotes Reuben lying with his father's concubine.
